newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street slips at open, then pull off lows.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street slips at open, then pull off lows.

text.p: U.S. shares fell in early trading Monday as investors took profits following Friday's strong session.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down around 22 points at 7774 above an initial intraday low of 7751.
The Nasdaq composite was up 1.44 points to 1448.54 after first slipping.
Shares of Philip Morris Cos Inc came under some pressure after Friday's announcement of a landmark settlement between the tobacco industry and U.S. states.
